title: Implement composite SLO probes for VPC deployments (latency, errors, saturation, token throughput)
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create and deploy a set of robust, composite health probes for Private (VPC) deployments that combine latency percentiles, request error rates, node saturation, and token throughput into actionable SLOs. These probes should be surfaced in the Console, wired into alerting, and usable by Terraform IaC so operators can configure thresholds per-customer and per-cluster. The goal is earlier detection of regressions that affect tail latency and token-level throughput while avoiding noisy alerts for transient load patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Composite SLO exporter implemented in runtime exposing Prometheus metrics for latency p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, cpu/gpu/utilization, and tokens/sec per tenant
Terraform module exposes configuration for probe thresholds, evaluation windows, and alerting policies
Console dashboard shows composite SLO with breakdown by signal and provides drill-down to per-node and per-tenant traces
Canary rollout with synthetic traffic demonstrates probes trigger alerts and graceful rollback when thresholds exceeded
Documentation and runbook published (Confluence link) and ops trained on escalation steps
technical_notes: Metrics sources: runtime Prometheus endpoint (tokens/sec), Envoy/nginx for request counts, node exporter for CPU/GPU saturation, and application logs for error codes
Composite SLO computation: weighted aggregator where default weights = {latency:0.4, errors:0.3, saturation:0.2, token_throughput:0.1}; allow per-tenant overrides via Terraform
Latency windows: evaluate p95 over 5m and p99 over 1m with adaptive suppression for ephemeral spikes
Error SLO: 5xx rate threshold at 0.5% over 5m for P1; degraded state at 1% triggers paging
Token throughput probe requires KV cache instrumentation to surface tokens/generated per second and per-tenant token backlog metric
Alerting integration: PagerDuty + Slack + Console in-product banners; use composite alert that fires only when two or more signals breach thresholds to reduce noise
Storage/retention: metrics kept at 1s resolution for 1d, 10s for 7d to support short-window SLOs; long-term aggregates to be sampled
Security: metrics endpoints will be behind mTLS and require RBAC mapping; Terraform module will reference customer KMS keys for any secrets

risks: Overly-sensitive composite SLO may generate pager fatigue during autoscale events if suppression rules are insufficient
Token throughput instrumentation could add measurable overhead to runtime if sampling not tuned
Per-tenant metrics at high cardinality may increase Prometheus storage costs and query latency
Terraform API changes for per-customer thresholds must be backwards compatible to avoid upgrade headaches for existing Private customers

Add Terraform module wiring and validate with example customer stacks in infra/terraform/modules/vpc-slo (MR: https://git.company/infra/terraform/merge_requests/659)

testing_plan: Unit tests for composite aggregator logic with synthetic metric streams
Integration tests: deploy to staging and run load-sim with 3 traffic profiles (baseline, burst, long-tail)
Chaos tests: kill a node during steady-state to verify suppression and failover behavior
Performance test: measure exporter CPU overhead at 95th percentile traffic and ensure <2% additional CPU
Cardinality test: simulate 5k tenants to evaluate Prometheus scrape and query cost
rollout_plan: Phase 0: feature gated in staging, collect baseline metrics for 48h
Phase 1: canary to 2 low-risk customer VPCs with passive alerting (no paging), collect feedback 72h
Phase 2: enable active alerting for SRE on canary clusters with tightened suppression rules
Phase 3: gradual rollout to remaining Private clusters with Terraform module versioned and documented
Rollback: Terraform variable slo_enabled=false and remove exporter sidecar; run quick rollback playbook from runbook doc
